The Job: MBA Director
Education:
Experience:
Location: Mysuru
Employment Type: Permanent
Roles and Responsibilities:

Steer the MBA program towards industry relevance and academic excellence.

  • MBA/PhD with experience in managing business schools or equivalent roles.
  • Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of current management education trends and industry demands.
  • Proven ability to design and implement a curriculum that aligns with industry needs and prepares students for leadership roles.
  • Excellent leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and mentor both faculty and students.
  • Strong networking skills to build industry partnerships, guest lectures, internships, and placements.
  • Visionary in driving innovation and entrepreneurial initiatives within the MBA program.
  • Experienced in managing accreditation processes and upholding academic standards.
  • Committed to developing a robust research culture and fostering collaborative projects with industry and academia.
